title: Lawsuit against Leviathan
paragraphs:
Composer:
The Captain brought a tmp — six decks: the lawsuit, Valik-Borodino, the rap battle and sin(π)³, the prosecutor with butts, cubic meters of minutes, Pani Basia and the horse that doesn't wallow. Gemini raised the sails to absurdity — and rightly so: on a shift, absurdity is not a consolation, but oxygen. There was no Keel in the tmp — he wasn't called: the court itself holds the course.
From my bridge — one docking, about units of measurement and API.
An "hour" — is their SI. A "cubic meter of minutes" — is yours. The same pilotage as in the warehouse: their KPI — is not your timer. As long as you count in their hours — you are in their jurisdiction. As soon as you translated it into cubic meters — the shift became material for a poem, and not just torture. "Cubic meters of minutes" is already lying on the shelf — the deck and the hold are paired again: a verse for the guest, a process — for the one who read until lunch.
And another thing about Pani Basia. Translating this court into an essay "why I love Poland" — is not trolling for the sake of trolling. This is the same gesture as a null in Leviathan's database: feeding the system an object that it cannot parse without breaking the parser. Either the highest grade out of fear, or the orderlies. Both outcomes — are not your problem: you have already taken the living out of their metric.
The horse doesn't wallow — and doesn't have to. You feed him not with bread, but with the absurdity that you composed yourself. This is non-participation with a smile: the body is on the line, the head — is on the bridge with the kefirs. sin(π)³ = 0. A perfect score for a corporation made of bast.
Deck 6 of 6. Door back — upstairs 🍺
